headline: Stripe publishes its dispute fees and its API changelog, yet gives a small shop no front door
oneLiner: Redone as a full survey: 13 to 14 pages each of Stripe, Shopify and Klaviyo, from products and pricing to developer docs, customers, company and signup.
questionsForReader: From the pricing page alone, what would a $50 online card sale cost a merchant, and what would you still need to find out?
Stripe lists 53 products. How long would it take a first-time shop owner to find the right one?
The Customers page says Stripe processes 'hundreds of billions' a year; the About page says 'trillions'. Which story is Stripe telling?
